/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization with pickle
 * @description Using pickle.load/loads on untrusted data can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/numpy-unsafe-pickle
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("_pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("numpy").getMember("load").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe pickle deserialization in numpy's file loading functions that could allow arbitrary code execution

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True or unsanitized user input can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/numpy-command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // subprocess.call/run/Popen with shell=True
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() and
    exists(DataFlow::Node shellArg |
      shellArg = call.getArgByName("shell") and
      shellArg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    )
  ) or
  (
    // os.system calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall()
  ) or
  (
    // os.popen calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("popen").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe command execution that could allow command injection."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection through subprocess calls with user-controlled input, particularly in distutils, f2py, and build tools
